constraints: Source-bound edit only: retain original slide geometry, shape order, relationship wiring, images, theme, and assets.
Exact text-binding cardinality is preserved in source order; no paragraphs, runs, line breaks, or objects are added or removed.
Footer, legal line, and slide number remain source-bound.
Text fit and capacity are unmeasured; this contract does not establish adaptation qualification.
Native rendering and visual review are required after application.
